FULL TEXT:
Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University
Centre of Excellence for Wildlife and Conservation Studies
Notification for Recruitment of Project Assistant (Project-Based)
Advertisement no. 04/2026
A walk-in Interviews for the Project Assistant (Project Based) at Centre of Excellence for
Wildlife & Conservation Studies, Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University, Junagadh, Gujarat,
India is scheduled on November 21, 2026 at 11:00 hrs at the office of the Director, CWCS. The
details of the posts such as qualifications, experience, remuneration, etc are given below:
Positions # Posts Qualifications & Experience Monthly
remuneration
Project Assistant 01 M.Sc. in Zoology / Wildlife
Science / Environment
Science / Life Science or
allied subjects
Desirable: Knowledge of
Mammals, Avifauna,
Herpetofauna, Entomology
Rs. 30000/- Fix
Job Responsibilities:
• Conduct field surveys, household surveys, GPS-based data collection, ground-truthing,
ecological and biodiversity assessments in the study area.
• Conduct data management, analysis, documentation, and preparation of technical
reports.
• Support in the preparation of final project reports and other documentation.
• Work in coordination with the Project Leaders for smooth project execution.
Interested and eligible candidates may walk in with their CV, Application form (as per the given
format) and all the relevant original documents with one set of photocopies at the following
address.
Reporting Time: 10:30 am
Venue: The Office of the Director, CWCS,
Department of Commerce and Management Building,
New Campus, Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University, Bilkha Road, Khadiya, Junagadh
(Location: https://maps.app.goo.gl/UKE5njobiWU4QfXb7)
For any queries, contact to wildlife@bknmu.edu.in
